name: Differentiable Voxelization via Smoothed Winding Numbers
definition: A method for voxelizing triangle meshes into smoothed winding number voxel grids that provides closed-form gradients with respect to mesh vertex positions, enabling gradient-based optimization of surface representations based on volumetric properties.
summary: Differentiable Voxelization via Smoothed Winding Numbers is a method that voxelizes triangle meshes into smoothed winding number grids, providing closed-form gradients for gradient-based optimization of surface representations.
